description_en: Queries the status of a Simple Log Service Logstore
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sls-log-store-status --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-uqm35000002 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSlsLogStoreStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: indicates the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: indicates regions outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

ExistStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether a Logstore is created for WAF. Valid values:

true: A Logstore is created.

false: No Logstore is created
ExistStatus.description_zh:
是否已创建WAF的日志库。取值：
true：已创建。
false：未创建
